# Ahavaco

> Ahavaco designs elegant, mobile-first wedding websites and online RSVP pages for Filipino couples, for a one-time ₱299 fee with no monthly hosting cost.

Ahavaco is a fully online, nationwide service in the Philippines. It works equally well for a garden wedding in Tagaytay, a beach wedding in Boracay, a garden or hotel wedding in Quezon City, or a celebration in Batangas, Antipolo, Baguio, Cebu, Metro Manila, or anywhere else in the country — the venue location never changes the price or process.

Each website is a personalized version of Ahavaco's standard template and can include: a digital invitation, a live wedding countdown, an "our story" section, ceremony/reception event details, venue and Google Maps links, an entourage list, a photo gallery, a dress code guide, an RSVP-ready section, and a guest FAQ.

## Pricing
- ₱299 one-time setup. The published website stays online for life with no monthly hosting fee.
- ₱150 per revision request after the site is approved and published. Corrections to Ahavaco's own mistakes are always free.
- Custom domains, if requested, are separate from the ₱299 package.

## How it works
1. The couple sends their names, date, venue, colors, text, photos, and RSVP details.
2. Ahavaco personalizes the standard template with that content.
3. The couple reviews and approves the draft.
4. The finished website is published as one shareable link, ready for messaging apps, social media, or a printed QR code.

## Pages
- Homepage (https://ahavaco.ph/): pricing, included features, how it works, FAQ.
- Live demo (https://ahavaco.ph/demo/): a full sample wedding website couples can preview.
